name: sound-order-sort
description: Sound Editor's Sort Sound Variables (Ctrl+R) against the WE's own save of war3map.w3s. Input sound-order.w3m (Delta, alpha, Charlie, bravo, Echo: mixed case, so by name without case and with it differ). WE (Sound Editor, F5): a sound selected, Ctrl+R. Studio: w3.sounds.sort. Ignored: each sound's file (the editor saves an empty file for a game sound it doesn't find under that name, whatever its extension). Expected MATCH
